# Obserwator

> Python library, CLI, REST API and MCP server for public hydrological and meteorological data: a versioned raw root of archives and a data root of station series, catalogs and analyses, current data and PMAXTP. Version 3.3.1. Providers: IMGW-PIB — Poland, ČHMÚ — Czechia, Gdańskie Wody — Poland, PIG-PIB — Poland. Datasets in the registry: 61. Commands of the catalog shared by every interface: 37 (groups: 8).

1. **Learn the commands:** `obserwator commands list --json`, then `obserwator commands schema --command … --json` (REST `GET /api/v1/commands/list`, `/schema`; MCP `obserwator_commands_list`, `obserwator_commands_schema`): options in `options`, other rules in `rules`, effects in `effects` (`writes`, `network`, `idempotent`).
2. **Check without writing:** `--check` (CLI), `?check=true` (REST, POST), `check: true` (MCP; the default of writing commands), `check_command()` (Python) → an `obserwator-plan/1` plan, nothing written or downloaded. `store check` is a check itself. Ask the user about a large plan.
3. **Run:** without `check`; read the `status` of the envelope, not only the exit code.
4. **Read offline:** `store info`, `store scan`, `series summary`, `series read` (`limit`/`cursor`), `pmaxtp read`.
5. **Decide by codes:** `code`, `status`, `items[].status`, `error_code`; `message` is for humans, `hint` names the option or command that fixes the error.

- Result: the JSON envelope `obserwator-result/1` (CLI: `--json`; without it a summary for a person) with the `status` field (`ok`, `partial`, `failed`, `cancelled`; CLI exit codes 0, 10, 11, 130).
- Error: `obserwator-error/1` `{schema, code, title, message, hint?, details, exit_code, command?}` in the last stderr line of the CLI and in MCP `isError` or `application/problem+json` in REST; codes from a closed registry, e.g. `validation_error` = 2 / 400.
- Datasets: full keys `<country>.<provider>.<dataset>`, e.g. `pl.imgw.hydro_daily`, `cz.chmu.hydro_daily`; station codes: IMGW-PIB 9 digits, ČHMÚ WIGOS identifier, Gdańskie Wody `GDANSKIEWODY-<no>`.
- Commands: `obserwator commands list --json` (summary) and `obserwator commands schema --json` (options), or `GET /api/v1/commands/list` and `/schema`; MCP tools `obserwator_commands_list` and `obserwator_commands_schema`; the full guide: `obserwator commands guide` or `GET /api/v1/commands/guide` (Polish: `--lang pl`, `?lang=pl`).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/Obserwator/main/AGENTS.md): guide for agents in English (Polish: `obserwator commands guide --lang pl`) — commands, datasets, flags, error codes, flows, what not to do
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/Obserwator/main/README.md): installation and examples for Python, CLI, REST, MCP
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/Obserwator/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, store, data flow
- [Changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/Obserwator/main/docs/CHANGELOG.md): changes and migration from 2.x
